command:
set -euo pipefail
pid=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p MainPID --value)
epoch=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --value)
echo IDENTITY_HOST=$(hostname)
echo IDENTITY_USER=$(id -un)
echo SERVICE_BEFORE_PID=$pid
echo SERVICE_BEFORE_EPOCH="$epoch"
echo HOST_ROOTFS_BEGIN
if sudo -n test -e /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run; then echo HOST_ROOTFS_EXISTS=1; sudo -n stat -c 'HOST_ROOTFS_INODE=%i MODE=%a TYPE=%F' /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run; else echo HOST_ROOTFS_EXISTS=0; fi
if sudo -n test -e /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share; then echo HOST_SHARE_EXISTS=1; else echo HOST_SHARE_EXISTS=0; fi
echo HOST_ROOTFS_END
echo PROC_ROOT_BEGIN
sudo -n readlink /proc/$pid/root || true
for rel in root/.local/share/agentzero/consciousness.db root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db root/.local/share/agentzero/welt.db root/.local/share/frank/db/amygdala.db root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db.vor-maerz-20260910; do p=/proc/$pid/root/$rel; echo PROC_DB_BEGIN=$p; if sudo -n test -f "$p"; then echo EXISTS=1; sudo -n stat -c 'BYTES=%s INODE=%i MTIME=%Y' "$p"; sudo -n sha256sum "$p" | awk '{print "SHA256="$1}'; else echo EXISTS=0; fi; echo PROC_DB_END=$p; done
echo PROC_ROOT_END
echo NSENTER_BEGIN
sudo -n nsenter -t "$pid" -m -- sh -c 'for p in /root/.local/share/agentzero/consciousness.db /root/.local/share/agentzero/unified.db /root/.local/share/agentzero/welt.db /root/.local/share/frank/db/amygdala.db /root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db /root/.local/share/frank/db/world_experience.db.vor-maerz-20260910; do echo NS_DB_BEGIN=$p; if [ -f "$p" ]; then echo EXISTS=1; stat -c "BYTES=%s INODE=%i MTIME=%Y" "$p"; sha256sum "$p" | awk "{print \"SHA256=\"\$1}"; else echo EXISTS=0; fi; echo NS_DB_END=$p; done'
echo NSENTER_END
echo MOUNTINFO_BEGIN
sudo -n awk '$5 ~ /entityos|rootfs-run/ || $4 ~ /entityos|rootfs-run/ {print}' /proc/$pid/mountinfo || true
echo MOUNTINFO_END
echo RESCUE_BEGIN
sudo -n test -f /var/lib/entityos/data/volatile-state-rescue/fred-20260913T0246p0700/MANIFEST.json && echo RESCUE_MANIFEST_EXISTS=1 || echo RESCUE_MANIFEST_EXISTS=0
sudo -n find /var/lib/entityos/data/volatile-state-rescue/fred-20260913T0246p0700 -maxdepth 8 -type f -printf '%P %s bytes\n' 2>/dev/null | sort || true
echo RESCUE_END
after_pid=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p MainPID --value)
after_epoch=$(systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveEnterTimestamp --value)
echo SERVICE_AFTER_PID=$after_pid
echo SERVICE_AFTER_EPOCH="$after_epoch"
[[ "$pid" == "$after_pid" && "$epoch" == "$after_epoch" ]] || { echo RUNTIME_EPOCH_DRIFT=1 >&2; exit 97; }
echo DONE=1
